a fine.exampleZh: 通知说埃伦收到了罚款。

verbal agreement.zh: 口头达成的同意或约定
verbal agreement.usageNote: a verbal agreement：双方口头达成的约定；本句指大厅预订时间，与书面合同分开。
verbal agreement.example: Ellen and Jo had reached a verbal agreement about an extra half-hour.
